name: Spectral Shift — each mode is a text change of its own kind
notes: Memory: project_text_change_audit_2026-11-18. The KNOWN_ABILITY_EFFECTS lookup never matched a mode's bullet line, so neither mode had an effect. The bullet is now dropped for the lookup and the modal pass gives each its mode; the pop-up, getEffectInfo and setTextChangeConfig take the mode picked (_textChangeEffect). With the colour mode picked, white becomes black on Honor of the Pure.
